description.value: Divided his household in 2287 and divided the culture with it, in a procedure the survey was permitted to watch and not to record, and which took nine days. He has since refused two requests to describe the procedure afterwards, saying that a description of it would be a second division and would need a second nine days. He is otherwise the most forthcoming informant at the terraces and has fed four expeditions at his own pits.

formOfAddress: by name and then the culture's name
